title: Filling in the years before Charlie Johnson: Fowler and Matson
summary: Berger asks about 1922-27; Carter recalls playing with Billy Fowler and Charlie Matson around New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, you know, people often say on the basis of your recordings, that one of your earliest bands that you played with was Charlie Johnsons.
Here we are talking about 1922, roughly, and you've got about 5 years here. Can you roughly fill in a little bit?
Can you do a little memory jogging of what went on at that time?

Good. Maybe what I'm talking about is really, probably, a little later than '22, because I know that I did play with Billy Fowler, who else did I play with? I did some playing around New York with, oh, some bands who did -- Charlie Matson.
M-a-t-s-o-n. Right. Gee whiz, who else?
